title: digest_doc
description: Digest projection of a documentation markdown file (docs/**/*.md, CLAUDE.md, or **/SHARED_*.md). Captures heading outline, fenced code-block inventory, referenced specdev commands, and referenced file paths for cross-doc drift checks.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a documentation digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root.

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

doc_path.description: Echo of source_file for ergonomic downstream lookup.

headings.description: All markdown headings in document order, each with its depth (1-6) and text.

code_blocks.description: Fenced code blocks in document order. Each entry records the declared language (empty string when no info-string) and the line count of the block body (excluding fence lines).

referenced_commands.description: Unique `specdev <subcommand>` mentions found in the document (e.g. 'specdev spec-check', 'specdev validate'). Subcommand only — flags excluded.

referenced_files.description: Markdown link targets that look like repository file paths (contain a slash or end with a recognised extension). External URLs are excluded.

frontmatter.description: Parsed YAML frontmatter block if present at the top of the document. Absent when no frontmatter exists or it could not be parsed. Stored as an arbitrary JSON object (free-form by design).

text.description: Heading text with the leading hashes and trailing whitespace stripped.

language.description: Info-string after the opening fence (e.g. 'bash', 'python', 'json'). Empty string when no info-string is given.

line_count.description: Number of lines inside the fence (excluding the opening and closing fence lines themselves).
